# Report Parameters
	report_params = {
	    'itemNo': self.view.params.itemNo,
	    'lot': self.view.params.lot,
	    'toteId': self.view.params.toteId,
	    'shift': self.view.params.shift,
	    'time': self.view.params.time,
	    'dryWeight': self.view.params.dryWeight,
	    'netWeight': self.view.params.netWeight
	}
	
	# Hardcoded Printer Name
	printer = "HP LaserJet M404"
	
	# Current Project Name
	projectName = system.util.getProjectName()
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("LabelPrinting")
	
	try:
	    logger.info("Starting Label Print")
	    logger.info("Printer: %s" % printer)
	    logger.info("Lot: %s" % self.view.params.lot)
	
	    settings = {
	        "primaryPrinterName": printer,
	        "copies": 1,
	        "useRaster": False
	    }
	
	    system.report.executeAndDistribute(
	        path="LabelPrinting",
	        project=projectName,
	        action="print",
	        actionSettings=settings,
	        parameters=report_params
	    )
	
	    logger.info("Label printed successfully")
	
	except Exception as e:
	    logger.error("Print Failed: %s" % str(e))
	
	    # Fallback: Open Report PDF in Browser
	    self.requestPrint(
	        target='LabelPrinting/Label',
	        documentTitle='Label_' + str(self.view.params.lot)
	    )

report_params = {
	    'itemNo': self.view.params.itemNo,
	    'lot': self.view.params.lot,
	    'toteId': self.view.params.toteId,
	    'shift': self.view.params.shift,
	    'time': self.view.params.time,
	    'dryWeight': self.view.params.dryWeight,
	    'netWeight': self.view.params.netWeight
	}
	print
	printer = self.view.params.selectedPrinter
	proj = system.util.getProjectName()
	
	try:
	    settings = {
	        "primaryPrinterName": printer,
	        "copies": 1,
	        "useRaster": False
	    }
	    system.report.executeAndDistribute(
	        path="LabelPrinting",
	        project=proj,
	        action="print",
	        actionSettings=settings,
	        parameters=report_params
	    )
	except Exception as e:
	    self.requestPrint(target='LabelPrinting/Label', documentTitle='Label_' + str(self.view.params.lot))

# Report parameters
	report_params = {
	    'itemNo': str(self.view.params.itemNo),
	    'lot': str(self.view.params.lot),
	    'toteId': str(self.view.params.toteId),
	    'shift': str(self.view.params.shift),
	    'time': str(self.view.params.time),
	    'dryWeight': str(self.view.params.dryWeight),
	    'netWeight': str(self.view.params.netWeight)
	}
	
	# Project name-ah hardcode panradhu dhaan best (None error varadhu)
	proj = "IKOLabel"
#	"WatchTower_DeleteDBConfig"
	filename = "Tote_Label_" + str(self.view.params.lot)
	
	try:
	    # PDF generate panrom
	    pdf_bytes = system.report.executeReport(
	        path="LabelPrinting",
	        project=proj,
	        parameters=report_params,
	        fileType="pdf"
	    )
	    
	    # Download trigger panrom
	    system.perspective.download(
	        filename=filename + ".pdf",
	        data=pdf_bytes,
	        contentType="application/pdf"
	    )
	    system.perspective.print("PDF Download triggered successfully!")
	
	except Exception as e:
	    # Error vantha browser console and gateway log-la print aagum
	    system.perspective.print("Download Error: " + str(e))
